package.description: Select the right pipe size every time.

en-US.description: Select the right pipe size every time.
en-US.longDescription: The Refrigerant Piping Design program determines the minimum pipe size required to deliver refrigerant between the compressor, condenser and evaporator within specified pressure loss limits. The program will also size vertical risers so that oil entrainment is assured.
en-US.name: Refrigerant Piping Design

zh-CN.description: 每次都能选择正确的管道尺寸
zh-CN.longDescription: System Design Load 程序可确定在指定压力损失限制内，将制冷剂从压缩机输送至冷凝器和蒸发器所需的最小管道尺寸。该程序还能计算垂直上升管的尺寸，以确保油的夹带效果。

package.longDescription: The Refrigerant Piping Design program determines the minimum pipe size required to deliver refrigerant between the compressor, condenser and evaporator within specified pressure loss limits. The program will also size vertical risers so that oil entrainment is assured.
package.name: Refrigerant Piping Design
